zh-CN.title: 好友日历文案修复
items: 名片忙闲条收细为 8px，仅用竖线标记当前时刻，移除条纹和多余分隔线
私聊改用日历按钮，图形与颜色概括今日安排，浮动框显示当前状态、下一空闲时段和完整日历
修复好友日历中的时间、忙碌占比和空闲时长未正确显示的问题

en.title: Friend calendar text fix
items: Profile timelines are now 8px thin, with a simple now marker and no hatching or extra divider
A calendar button in direct chats summarizes today's load and opens current status, upcoming availability and the full calendar
Fixed unresolved time, busy percentage and free-duration placeholders in friend calendars
